title: Bavarian Fish Soup
description: A hearty German-inspired fish soup originating from Bavaria. This comforting dish is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, carrot, and potato. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add fish and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and let simmer for 10 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup slightly.
Stir in whipped cream and Malaysian fish sauce (if using).
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley (optional).
